content.text: `toString()` output confirms Lombok's `@Data` is generating getters, setters, `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString` correctly.

Project is set up and verified:

- **`pom.xml`** — Maven project (`com.example:app`), Java 21 target, Lombok `1.18.38` as a `provided` dependency wired into `maven-compiler-plugin`'s annotation processor path, JUnit 5 for tests.
- **`User.java`** — example model using `@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor` to generate getters/setters/`equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`/constructors instead of hand-written boilerplate.
- **`App.java`** — demo entry point.
- **`UserTest.java`** — verifies the Lombok-generated methods behave correctly.
- **`.gitignore`** — excludes `target/` and IDE files.

`mvn test` passes (2/2) and `mvn exec:java` confirms the generated `toString`/constructor work at runtime. Started with Lombok 1.18.34 but it crashed the compiler on this machine's JDK 25 (`TypeTag :: UNKNOWN` error, a known incompatibility); bumped to 1.18.38, the latest release, which resolved it.

result:
Project is set up and verified:

- **`pom.xml`** — Maven project (`com.example:app`), Java 21 target, Lombok `1.18.38` as a `provided` dependency wired into `maven-compiler-plugin`'s annotation processor path, JUnit 5 for tests.
- **`User.java`** — example model using `@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor` to generate getters/setters/`equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`/constructors instead of hand-written boilerplate.
- **`App.java`** — demo entry point.
- **`UserTest.java`** — verifies the Lombok-generated methods behave correctly.
- **`.gitignore`** — excludes `target/` and IDE files.

`mvn test` passes (2/2) and `mvn exec:java` confirms the generated `toString`/constructor work at runtime. Started with Lombok 1.18.34 but it crashed the compiler on this machine's JDK 25 (`TypeTag :: UNKNOWN` error, a known incompatibility); bumped to 1.18.38, the latest release, which resolved it.
